claim: QuickPose prices its pose-estimation SDK by monthly active device, counted once per month however many sessions it runs.
quote: Pricing is based on monthly active devices — a device is counted once per month regardless of how many sessions it runs.

claim: Its pricing page defines one as "any unique device that uses QuickPose features at least once in a calendar month".
quote: A monthly active device is any unique device that uses QuickPose features at least once in a calendar month.

claim: Personal: free, no card required, up to 10 monthly active devices.
quote: Up to 10 devices is free — no card required.

claim: Device limits for Personal, Builder, Starter, Launch and Scale: 10, 100, 1,000, 2,000 and 5,000.
quote: Monthly active devices | 10 | 100 | 1,000 | 2,000 | 5,000 |

claim: Prices for Personal, Builder, Starter, Launch and Scale: free, $25, $50, $100 and $200 a month.
quote: Price | Free | $25/mo | $50/mo | $100/mo | $200/mo |

claim: Growth: $400 a month for up to 10,000 monthly active devices.
quote: Growth $ 400 per month

claim: Growth: up to 10,000 monthly active devices.
quote: Up to 10,000 monthly devices

claim: Agency: $1,000 a month.
quote: Agency $ 1,000 per month

claim: Agency: up to 100,000 monthly active devices.
quote: Up to 100,000 monthly devices

claim: Custom: over 100,000 devices, custom SLA and contract, dedicated account manager, NDA available.
quote: Yes, for over 100,000 monthly devices or enterprise requirements including custom SLAs, NDAs, and dedicated support.

claim: All SDK capabilities are on every plan including the free Personal tier; the plans differ only in device limits and support level.
quote: All SDK capabilities — including rep counting, yoga pose detection, range of motion, joint angle tracking, and sports biomechanics — are available on every plan including the free Personal tier. The plans differ only in device limits and support level.

claim: Going over does not switch the SDK off; you receive an invoice at the end of the month with your final device numbers.
quote: QuickPose will continue working in your app. Your device usage is calculated on a monthly basis, therefore you will receive an invoice at the end of the month with your final device numbers.

claim: Billing runs monthly through Stripe, charged on the 1st for the previous month, with no setup fees or long-term contracts on standard plans.
quote: Plans are billed monthly via Stripe. You'll be charged on the 1st of each month for the previous months usage. There are no setup fees or long-term contracts on standard plans.

claim: Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.
quote: Cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing period

claim: Charging your own users is allowed.
quote: You're free to monetise your app however you choose

claim: Integration Support: QuickPose's engineers integrate the SDK into your iOS or Android app; on request, minimum 4 hours.
quote: Our engineering team integrates QuickPose directly into your iOS or Android app, configured to your specific use case, exercises, and UI. Minimum 4 hours.

claim: Code Audit: $150 an hour, minimum 2 hours.
quote: Minimum 2 hours. $150 per hour

claim: Custom Exercise Development for a movement not in the standard library.
quote: Our AI team builds and trains custom models specifically for your use case.

claim: Its plan comparison table also marks on-device processing on every plan it lists.
quote: On-device processing

claim: A fixed-fee proof of concept "typically 4–8 weeks".
quote: A tightly scoped proof of concept with defined deliverables, timeline and price — typically 4–8 weeks.

claim: Containerised deployment inside your own Azure tenancy or private cloud.
quote: Containerised deployments run inside your own Azure tenancy or private cloud

claim: The iOS SDK README says "Get your free SDK key on https://dev.quickpose.ai, usage limits may apply", and keys are linked to the bundle ID.
quote: usage limits may apply. SDK Keys are linked to your bundle ID

claim: The Android README says the same for the Play Store.
quote: please check Key before distributing to the Play Store.

claim: The older SDK FAQ on the JointTrack pricing page says you move to the Launch tier above 100 monthly active devices.
quote: You move to the Launch tier if your app has more than 100 monthly active devices.

claim: The JointTrack page FAQ says education, non-profit, charity and volume pricing is available.
quote: Special pricing for education, non profit organizations, charities, as well as volume discounts are available.

claim: JointTrack is a separate QuickPose image-annotation API.
quote: Image Processing API to add range of motion annotations to images and receive results in a json format.

claim: QuickPose's terms license the SDK under Apache 2.0 subject to the agreement.
quote: QuickPose AI SDK and JointTrack API are licensed to the User under the Apache 2.0 license, subject to the terms of this agreement.

claim: Their use "may be subject to fees".
quote: The use of QuickPose AI SDK and JointTrack API may be subject to fees, which the User agrees to pay in a timely manner.

claim: The terms name Sliced Backhand Ltd as QuickPose's owner.
quote: QuickPose is owned and operated by Sliced Backhand Ltd.

claim: Governed by the laws of the United Kingdom.
quote: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of United Kingdom

claim: The iOS SDK repository carries an Apache-2.0 LICENSE file.
quote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004

claim: Sency's main pricing page: a free trial and then a paid monthly fee for the first 100 active users.
quote: After that, you'll start paying a minimal monthly fee to continue building and testing, which includes access for up to 100 active users.

claim: Sency's packages page: a free Starter plan for up to 100 monthly active users.
quote: Up to 100 monthly active users

claim: Sency's packages page: a Growth plan from $499 a month.
quote: Publish & Monetize From $499 / month

claim: Sency's packages page: Growth up to 3,800 monthly active users.
quote: Up to 3,800 monthly active users

claim: Sency's packages page: $0.79 per active user.
quote: $0.79 per active user

claim: Kemtai's site routes buyers to a demo request.
quote: Please enter your business email to receive more information and a demo

claim: KinesteX's FAQ describes usage-based plans.
quote: Our pricing is adaptable to your use case and business model, with usage-based plans that scale to support clients of different sizes.

claim: KinesteX: priced per active user per month, falling as you reach new tiers.
quote: The pricing per-active-user-per-month will smoothly go down as you scale and reach new tiers.

claim: KinesteX: integration fees may apply.
quote: Integration fees may apply depending on the complexity of your requirements

claim: KinesteX access starts with a contact form.
quote: To get demo access and your API key, fill out the contact form on our website.
